summary.intent: Capture implementation decisions for Phase 20 (Vault Migration) via discuss-phase, then kick off plan-phase to research and create executable PLAN.md files for moving rootFolderKey from the database into IPFS vault blob v2 format.
summary.outcome: CONTEXT.md was created and committed on a feature branch with all key migration decisions locked. plan-phase ran successfully: research (20-RESEARCH.md) and validation strategy (20-VALIDATION.md) were generated and committed; planner and checker agents were spawned as part of the standard workflow.

repo: Vault blob v2 format is defined as: 0x02 | uint16 key_length | ECIES_key | AES_GCM_metadata — this is the migration target format
encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey are both stored on the vault DB row and both need to be NULLed post-migration (not just one)
IPNS key is HKDF-derivable, making the stored DB copy redundant — already confirmed in desktop Rust code
Phase 18 added server-side Prometheus histograms for IPNS resolve/publish; client-side end-to-end journey timing (login-to-vault) is planned for Phase 22
Kubo performance is a known bottleneck and active infra work is in-flight — silent DB fallback is the safety net until Kubo proves out
Blob v2 logic will live in @cipherbox/core (TypeScript) with a Rust equivalent in the desktop app
Migration fires on next login, not on publish — dormant accounts are not force-migrated
Per-user phased rollout is gated by a migratedAt timestamp on the vault row

code.finding: Contains encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey columns — both to be NULLed after v2 blob is confirmed written, with column DROP deferred until all users migrated
Vault initialization logic lives here in @cipherbox/core — home for blob v2 read/write in TypeScript
Vault type definitions — will need updating for blob v2 format
API vault service — migration trigger (on next login) and dual-write logic lands here
Web client vault store — needs v2 blob parsing on login read path
Desktop Rust vault commands — confirmed IPNS key is HKDF-derivable; needs Rust blob v2 write on root folder publish

workflow: The discuss-phase workflow skips already-decided gray areas from prior CONTEXT.md files — Phase 19/19.1 decisions (IPNS resolution strategy, SDK architecture) were carried forward without re-asking
Silent DB fallback is the recommended pattern when introducing a new IPFS-dependent login flow — allows gradual rollout and benchmarking before cutting over
The commit signing failure (1Password agent unavailable in subprocess) is a known friction point — the workaround is to commit from a signing-capable terminal
The assistant correctly caught that it should not commit directly to main and created a feature branch (docs/phase-20-context) before committing

friction: git commit failed mid-workflow because the 1Password signing agent was unavailable in the subprocess context — user was AFK and missed the notification
Initial commit attempt was targeting main instead of a feature branch — caught and corrected after user pointed it out
System readiness question was framed too narrowly initially, requiring a follow-up free-text exchange to capture the Kubo performance context
open_items: Column DROP migration for encryptedRootFolderKey and encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey — deferred until all users have been migrated to v2 blob
IPFS-only retry-then-error mode (removing silent DB fallback) — deferred until Kubo performance improvements prove out in production
Client-side end-to-end 'first login → fully loaded vault' baseline metrics — Phase 22 will add this instrumentation
